allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: KAMOPAINTS: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about the allotment of 2,125 equity shares by Kamdhenu Colour and Coatings Limited, a wholly owned & material subsidiary, on a right issue basis to the Company.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: KAMOPAINTS: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 15000000 equity shares pursuant to conversion of warrants issued on a preferential basis.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about the allotment of 3,614 Equity Shares by Kamdhenu Colour and Coatings Limited on a right issue basis.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 1,46,45,000 Equity Shares pursuant to conversion of warrant into equity issued on Preferential basis.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 2,96,45,000 warrants convertible into Equity shares.

allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of Board for Preferential issue of  2,96,45,000 warrants convertible into equity at price of Rs. 6.80 per warrant to promoter group entity.
